selection_basis: Inspect all 276 frozen mappings, all 22/199 authored corpus inputs and eight old plans first; deeply review the nine selected exact alpha.6 primary source predicates and binary ancestry. Remaining-rule dispositions are priority/intent/capability gaps, not a false claim of exhaustive per-rule primary review.
selection_criteria: Distinct useful local-declaration/guarded-expression/value-body concern absent from the prior corpus, not a target rule count.
Exact syntax route with pinned core primary predicate and no RequiresAnalysisApi ancestry.
Concrete valid alternative, behavior/identity boundary or known misleading advice, genuine options where meaningful; no generated count-only positives.
Preserve advisory/opt_in/severity/certainty and every full-catalog gap; no inferred semantic/FQN, automatic rewrite or architecture authority.
